plainText:
Cherami Leigh is an American actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Leigh was born on July 19, 1988, in . She began working for Funimation Entertainment, Bang Zoom! Entertainment, and Studiopolis as an adult. In addition to her voice-over work, Leigh also worked on live-action TV shows. Leigh's first Pokémon-related voice work was as Iris in Pokémon Generations. She joined at the start of , where she voiced recurring character Chloe. Leigh is currently represented by A3 Artists Agency.
